title: Add detailed pada information to current nakshatra display

requirements.summary: Create a comprehensive pada data structure containing all 108 pada descriptions (4 padas for each of the 27 nakshatras) with nakshatra name, pada number, degree range, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description text
acceptanceCriteria: Data structure includes all 27 nakshatras with 4 padas each (108 total)
Each pada entry contains nakshatra name, pada number, degree range, navamsa sign, title, and complete description text
All provided pada descriptions from Ashwini through Shravana are accurately captured

file_operations.description: Create a new TypeScript file containing the complete pada data structure with all 108 pada entries. Define a TypeScript interface for PadaInfo with fields: nakshatraName (string), padaNumber (1-4), degreeRange (string), navamsaSign (string), title (string), description (string). Export a constant array or map structure containing all pada descriptions provided by the user, ensuring each of the 27 nakshatras has exactly 4 pada entries with their complete interpretive text.

requirements.summary: Extend the nakshatraEngine utility to calculate the current pada (1-4) based on the Moon's precise degree position within the nakshatra's 13°20' range
acceptanceCriteria: Function calculates current pada by dividing nakshatra degree range into 4 equal parts (3°20' each)
Returns pada number (1-4) along with current nakshatra
Calculation updates in real-time with Moon position changes

file_operations.description: Add a new function calculateCurrentPada that takes the Moon's ecliptic longitude and returns both the nakshatra number and pada number (1-4). Calculate the pada by determining the Moon's position within the current nakshatra's 13°20' span, dividing this into 4 equal parts of 3°20' each. Return an object containing both nakshatraNumber and padaNumber. Update the getCurrentNakshatra function to also return the pada number by calling this new calculation function.

requirements.summary: Update the CurrentNakshatraBanner component to display the current pada information including pada number, navamsa sign, title, and full interpretive description representing the current lunar climate
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays current pada number (1-4) alongside nakshatra name
Shows navamsa sign and pada title
Displays full pada description text in a readable format
Updates automatically when Moon transitions to a new pada
Visual presentation is consistent with existing banner design

file_operations.description: Import the pada data structure from frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts. Update the component to retrieve the current pada number from the useCurrentNakshatra hook (which now returns pada information). Look up the corresponding pada details from the pada data structure using the current nakshatra name and pada number. Display the pada number, navamsa sign, and pada title prominently within the banner. Add a section to display the full pada description text in a readable format, potentially using a collapsible or expandable UI pattern if the text is lengthy. Ensure the component updates automatically when the Moon transitions to a new pada by leveraging the existing 5-minute refresh interval from the useCurrentNakshatra hook. Maintain the existing cosmic/violet design aesthetic and banner structure.

Update the hook to return not just the current nakshatra but also the current pada number. Modify the return type to include the pada number (1-4) by calling the updated getCurrentNakshatra function from nakshatraEngine that now returns pada information. Ensure the hook continues to refresh every 5 minutes as specified in the constraints.

requirements.summary: Add a visual indicator or emphasis showing that the displayed pada information represents the current lunar climate and emotional atmosphere
acceptanceCriteria: Clear visual treatment distinguishes current pada as representing present lunar climate
Language or labeling emphasizes real-time lunar influence
Design maintains cosmic/astronomical aesthetic of existing interface

file_operations.description: Add visual emphasis to indicate the pada information represents the current lunar climate. Include a label or heading such as 'Current Lunar Climate' or 'Present Lunar Atmosphere' above or near the pada details. Consider adding a subtle animation, glow effect, or icon (such as a moon phase indicator) to draw attention to the real-time nature of the information. Use the existing OKLCH color system from the theme (purple/violet palette) to maintain the cosmic aesthetic. Ensure the visual treatment is distinct but harmonious with the existing banner design.
